line.en: the christmas market at skansen is open 10:00 to 16:00 on sunday, inside the usual skansen entry. it runs until 20 december.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt auf skansen ist am sonntag von 10 bis 16 uhr geöffnet, im normalen skansen-eintritt. er läuft bis zum 20. dezember.
line.tr: skansen'deki noel pazarı pazar günü 10:00 ile 16:00 arası açık, skansen'in normal girişiyle. 20 aralık'a kadar sürüyor.

sparks.why: Skansen's christmas market press release gives 27 Nov to 20 Dec 2026, and the Visit Stockholm listing for 29 Nov shows 10:00 to 16:00.
